title: NotesLoomBacklinksNavigationTransclusionAndMediaConnectivity
clause: Complete Notes-to-Loom backlinks, graph, search, transclusion, media and cross-project shared-access workflows.

current_source_discovery: Inspect accepted Notes identity and Loom graph/media APIs plus every Notes navigation/editor command.
Write RED flows for link insertion, backlink navigation, transclusion, media embed and cross-project share/revoke.
stop_conditions: A visible Notes feature would use a separate relation or search model.
Cross-project connectivity lacks explicit shared-access authority.

scope.summary: Make Notes a fully connected surface of Loom: text, media, code and domain references can link, backlink, transclude, search and navigate across authorized projects while the canonical RichDocument remains the editable source.
forbidden_paths: Synthetic navigation proof without real canonical records
acceptance_criteria: Notes link insertion resolves typed canonical Loom/domain targets and stores native Surreal relations with source range, relation kind and provenance.
Backlinks, graph, search, breadcrumbs and recent/history navigation open the canonical Notes/RichDocument target and preserve editor selection when supported.
Transclusions and media embeds render current authorized source state, show provenance/broken/denied-safe states and never create an independently editable copy.
Cross-project Notes links require explicit shared-access relations; revoke/context switch removes content and invalidates stale navigation safely.
Native keyboard, drag/embed, link-picker and open-in-related-surface workflows pass Argus, accessibility, layout and renderer-error checks.
proof_targets: Run real-Surreal Notes link/backlink/transclusion/media and cross-project grant/revoke E2E tests.
Run native editor/link-picker/drag/embed/navigation tests with real records.
Capture Argus state matrix for resolved, ambiguous, broken, denied, revoked and loading states.

same_project_private_resource_cases: A visible note does not reveal links to another member's private note/media.
derived_resource_non_widening_cases: Backlink, transclusion, preview and search visibility is source-scope intersection.
revocation_and_context_switch_cases: Open transclusions and navigation caches invalidate immediately or on bounded revalidation.
remote_saas_mcp_sync_cases: Remote links remain unresolved/quarantined until explicitly mapped and granted.
metadata_side_channel_cases: Target titles, types, thumbnails, backlink counts and ambiguous candidates are hidden when denied.

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.evidence: link, resolve, navigate, embed, deny and revoke events
resolution, broken-link, projection and navigation health
editor/render/freeze recovery with canonical operation IDs

risk_if_missed: Notes remains an isolated editor and Loom's backlinks cannot connect Handshake's IDE and creative workflows.

risks: Backlink navigation targets a projection copy.

research_provenance.selected_approach: Canonical Notes content connected through typed Loom relations, native graph/search and explicit cross-project grants.
